The '''G-32 evasive armor plating''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] developed by [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe Corporation]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Custom-designed by Santhe engineers for each supported class of starship, the G-32 plating increased the ship's maneuverability by accommodating the ship's shape, thruster locations, and gravity field generators.
